title: Person: Parnell
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Parnell

anchor.prefix:
the people and heard him say in a loud voice of sorrow over the waters:

 —He is dead. We saw him lying upon the catafalque. A wail of sorrow went up from the people.

 —Parnell!
anchor.suffix:
! He is dead!

 They fell upon their knees, moaning in sorrow.

 And he saw Dante in a maroon velvet dress and with a green velvet mantle hanging from her shoulders walking proudly
